cause.description: The type of damage that is applied to entities that enter the damage range.

damage_cooldown.description: Attack cooldown (in seconds) for how often this entity can attack a target.

damage_per_tick.description: How much damage per tick is applied to entities that enter the damage range.

damage_range.description: How close a hostile entity must be to have the damage applied.

death_message_override.description: A localization key to use as the death message when the area attack kills an entity. If empty, the default death message for the damage cause is used.

entity_filter.description: The set of entities that are valid to apply the damage to when within range.

play_attack_sound.description: If the entity should play their attack sound when attacking a target.

use_self_as_damage_source.description: If the entity should use itself as the damage source when attacking a target. If set to `false`, the target entity won't retaliate and its `minecraft:damage_sensor` won't be able to identify the attacker as the damage source.

description: A component that does damage to entities that get within range.
